message: I came to the outdoor training ground together with Asahi.

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, there's nothing here.」
The indoor training ground is better equipped and has a much nicer environment, but unfortunately, it's completely booked right now.

name: Iori
message: 「I really wanted to use <d0085>Yorishiro-kun</d> again after all this time, though.」
Yorishiro-kun—officially known as the "Hiraga Computational Spirit-Type Prototype Unit YSR-04E"—is a system that makes full use of Holographic Reality.
In addition to status indicators for reviewing data, it can project Origami and opponents to simulate actual matches.
However, there's no Yorishiro-kun out here. We can only do basic practice, though I suppose that's more than enough for today.

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, how do I look?」
Asahi came back after changing into her Spirit-Type Armament.

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, looking sharp. It suits you really well.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Thank you very much.」
Seeing Asahi looking so gallant in her Spirit-Type Armament makes me genuinely happy to see how much she's grown.

name: Iori
message: 「I wonder how many years it's been since I last sparred with Asahi-chan.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, you went back to calling me Asahi-chan.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, sorry. Pretty pathetic of me when I was the one who brought it up.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, let's work on changing it gradually.」
Man, Asahi really is a good kid.

name: Asahi
message: 「Even so, having Iori-sensei give me a coaching bout like this feels like a dream.」

name: Asahi
message: 「You have no idea how long I've been waiting for this moment...」

name: Iori
message: 「Was I really that good at teaching？」
I was still just an academy student back then, so I don't think I was all that mature or anything.

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes—so good that I've permanently preserved it as my happiest memory.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see. Well, if it made you happy, I'm glad.」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright then, how about we cross blades while reminiscing about old times?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Please instruct me！」
I draw my Origami and point its tip toward Asahi.

name: Iori
message: （...Oh, right.）
Seeing Asahi's stance jogs my memory.
She turns half-sideways in a low, hip-level stance, keeping her Origami sheathed.
What she uses is Iai quick-draw swordsmanship—a quintessential counter-type style that unleashes its blade with godlike drawing speed.

name: Iori
message: （That drawing strike of his was something else...）
In Asahi's stance, I see the shadow of my late best friend, Takahisa.
Perhaps because they are siblings, their stances are identical.

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei？ I'm already ready.」

name: Iori
message: 「My apologies, I was just reminiscing.」
Seeing Asahi’s stance, now grown to the same level as the student I was when I first met Takahisa, I couldn't help but fall into a wave of sentiment.

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, reminiscing is fine, but please watch me as I am now.」

name: Iori
message: 「You're right. Let me see just how much you've grown！」
Height, stride, arm length, blade length inferred from the scabbard—I immediately gauge the distance from these visual cues.
Stopping just on the edge of her range, aiming to draw a false strike—

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe...！」
The moment I thought Asahi smiled.
A flash like lightning—the first strike, delivered at a speed impossible to track. It took everything I had just to parry it.
Asahi’s follow-up strike, delivered with breathless timing, heavily depletes my arm's VF.
Having confirmed the hit, Asahi lightly kicks off the ground to regain her distance. The Origami she had drawn is already back in its scabbard before I even noticed.

name: Iori
message: 「...I'm surprised. Your reach is greater than I thought.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, thank you. But Iori-sensei is impressive as well.」

name: Asahi
message: 「You're the first person at this academy to parry my opening strike, Iori-sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I doubt the other students here could evade that...」
A strike delivered at the exact moment when the opponent hasn't yet secured their distance.
It was only because I had spent so much time sparring with Takahisa, who fought in this exact style, that I was able to react to Asahi now.
Under normal circumstances, one would definitely be struck; with that kind of momentum, a single blow like that could easily decide the match the moment it lands.
Truly, a one―strike kill―

name: Iori
message: 「But I’ve got your measure now！」
I lunge into Asahi's reach and swat away the opening strike of her god-speed Iai.
Realizing she's at a disadvantage, Asahi immediately retreats to a distance more favorable to her.

name: Asahi
message: 「As expected of Iori-sensei, you read it.」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course. I won't make the same mistake twice.」
While Iai-style drawing strikes are incredibly powerful in an opening move, they are easy to deal with once their range and speed are memorized.
Since the position of the blade is constant, the available techniques are inevitably more limited compared to other styles that utilize multiple stances.

name: Iori
message: 「Come on, Asahi. This is where you show me what you've got...！」

name: Iori
message: 「I won't let you get away！！」
I deflect her draw-strike and press in on Asahi. Giving her no time to sheathe her blade, I bear down on her all at once.
Caught in my relentless flurry of strikes, Asahi can't resheathe her sword. It's a tough spot for a battoujutsu practitioner.

name: Iori
message: 「What's the matter, Asahi? Takahisa used to counter this much without even breaking a sweat！?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Now that's infuriating!」
Even as she says she's infuriated, Asahi doesn't take the bait. She keeps calmly parrying my incoming strikes one after another.

name: Iori
message: 「Then how about this—！？」
Flowing out of a deflecting slash, I snap back at a sharp angle, unleashing a strike from an impossible trajectory.
I unleashed a serious strike to test Asahi's adaptability, and yet.

name: Asahi
message: 「...Iori-sensei, aren't you holding back a bit too much？ I'm not a child anymore, you know.」
Asahi, catching my blade and smiling serenely.

name: Iori
message: 「You've really grown.」
She fends off my relentless barrage and doesn't even let my serious strike through. Truly an ironclad defense.
Asahi has always been good at defending herself, and now she's honed it even further.

name: Asahi
message: 「I'd like to see your true art soon, Iori-sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「...I've got that sealed away right now, though.」
By "true art," Asahi must mean the swordsmanship style I've mastered.

name: Asahi
message: 「What a waste. Why did you seal it away？」

name: Iori
message: 「Because something like that has no place in Jindou.」
Jindou is strictly a sport. Swordsmanship meant for killing people has no business being used here.

name: Asahi
message: 「And yet, without it, you couldn't have taken the title of Toujinegi from my brother.」

name: Asahi
message: 「You won't be able to beat me like that, you know.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Because right now, I'm stronger than my brother was back then.」
Heh, quite the provocation.

name: Iori
message: 「...You're right, Asahi. You've gotten far stronger than I thought. You must have been training relentlessly.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes. I like to think I've worked harder than most.」
I can sense a fierce pride in her own abilities radiating from Asahi. She must be remarkably confident.
If that's what Asahi wants, I'm not averse to breaking my own taboo.

name: Iori
message: 「...All right. Just this once, got it?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, I'm glad.」
I tightened my grip on my Origami and shifted my core.
I hadn't used it in a long time, yet the stance drilled into me since childhood settled naturally into my body.

name: Iori
message: 「The essence of Muragaki, <d0034>Tengen Saimei―ryuu</d>―here I come.」
Instantly, a crease formed between Asahi's brows.
As I held my Origami at the ready without moving, Asahi began edging backward.
I took a step forward to close the distance.
As if overwhelmed by the pressure, Asahi retreated a large step.

name: Iori
message: 「What's wrong, Asahi? Shrinking back already?」
When I called out, Asahi's hand resting on the hilt of her sheathed Origami twitched sharply.
She seemed terribly on edge.

name: Asahi
message: 「Facing this again after so long really is tough...！」
Asahi's gaze darted around restlessly.
Anyone seeing this for the first time probably wouldn't understand what I was doing.

name: Asahi
message: 「Hah... huff, haah...！」
While to an onlooker I was merely standing still on the spot, Asahi's breathing grew rougher with every passing second.
―The Swordsman―Killer.
For generations, the Muragaki Family served as the shogunate's Oniwabanshu, cutting down those who turned against the bakufu.
The swordsmanship created by that very Muragaki clan—that is Tengen Saimei-ryuu.
Tengen Saimei-ryuu's opening move is 'Reader-Killer,' which continuously throws off an opponent's reads at high speed through minute movements while remaining in place.
Having faced countless master swordsmen, Muragaki knows full well that this tactic is especially effective against high-level practitioners.
Before Saimei-ryuu, a swordsman is forced into a state of extreme tension.
Then, once they are utterly exhausted in both body and mind, it unleashes a lethal strike.
That is the fundamental pattern of Tengen Saimei-ryuu.

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, mind if I come at you soon？」

name: Asahi
message: 「If anything, I wish you'd hurry up and come at me...！」
Because Iai quick-draw swordsmanship lives and dies by the counter-initiative, reading the opponent's hand completely is of utmost importance.
For someone like Asahi, Tengen Saimei-ryuu works with devastating effectiveness.
Responding to my half-step forward, Asahi slightly unlatched her blade from the scabbard. However, that was just a feint.

name: Iori
message: 「Huff！」
As I let out a deep breath, Asahi dropped her center of gravity. Yet this too was just a feint.

name: Iori
message: 「If it's too much for you, you're welcome to make the first move, you know？」

name: Asahi
message: 「……I think I'll refrain.」
Indeed, if she got impatient and rushed in, she'd be playing right into my hands.
Tengen Saimei-ryuu, much like Iai, excels most in the 'winning after the opponent moves' principle.
By neutralizing any reading of my intent, I can completely dismantle the opponent's strategy. It is only because such a thing is possible that it is a 'killing blow.'
Perhaps losing patience, Asahi takes a wide step back.

name: Asahi
message: 「I had wanted to save this for a little longer, but……！」
Asahi's hair began to sway and drift through the air.
A tremendous fighting spirit surged through Asahi's body as she took her stance.

name: Asahi
message: 「……The Martial Festival final, where Iori-san fought my brother when he was a second-year at the academy—I watched it over and over again, dozens of times.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Back then, my brother stood unrivaled among the students as a swordsman who used Iai.」

name: Asahi
message: 「And the one who defeated that brother of mine…… was you, Iori-san.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Both my brother and I are swordsmen who use Iai.」

name: Asahi
message: 「If that is the case, then surely, the one standing in my way as my final enemy must be someone like you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「If I cannot defeat you, Kuki cannot become the Toujinegi……！」
I see…… so that was the resolve with which Asahi was facing me.
Is that why she sought out the Tengen Saimei-ryuu from me?

name: Asahi
message: 「For these past few years, I have thought of nothing but how I could defeat you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Please, let me confirm the answer to that here……！！」
Asahi had come to this academy carrying the weight of her brother's defeat on her shoulders.
For an Asahi in that state, meeting me again was the greatest stroke of good fortune imaginable. That must be why she had been so happy.
For Asahi, this must truly be about avenging Takahisa—

name: Iori
message: 「……You're really going to give this everything you've got, aren't you？」

name: Asahi
message: 「That's a rather boorish question to ask a swordsman.」

name: Asahi
message: 「But…… it's precisely because you're that kind of person, Iori-san, that I like you.」
She cast a piercing gaze at me, charging it with genuine killing intent. Yet, she still managed to offer a smile.

name: Iori
message: 「……You've become a fine swordsman, Asahi.」
I truly think so.
And that is precisely why—I must respond to her with everything I have.

name: Iori
message: 「Here I come.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Whenever you're ready.」
No matter how things turn out, this single blow will decide the match.
Closing the distance in a flash—and unleashing a strike of instantaneous speed from her blind spot！
A lethal blade aimed at his neck—but Asahi doesn't dodge. She doesn't even try to defend.
Sucking into his neck as if drawn in—but, before it reaches Asahi—
Thirty centimeters short, the blade is obstructed by something invisible.
This is—！ But Asahi is not one to miss the opening created in that split second.

name: Asahi
message: 「Secret Technique, <d0035>Ouitsu Issen</d>—！！！！」
A truly lethal distance, a strike that spells certain death.
The sword guard in Asahi’s hand glitters—and a strike as if to split the very space in two is unleashed.
She poured all the spiritual power she possessed into that single blade.
Even Victoria, sturdy as she is, probably wouldn't be able to withstand this.
But—
Asahi, with the tip of a blade pointed at her neck, speaks quietly and exhales.

name: Asahi
message: 「You saw that attack just now, didn't you?」

name: Iori
message: 「No way I could see something like that.」
The final strike Asahi unleashed was truly at the speed of lightning.
There was no sign of a preliminary movement, and if one waited to see it, dodging would be impossible.
It was only by limiting the vector of the attack in advance with the Tengen Saimei-ryuu's Reader-Killer that he was able to avoid it.

name: Asahi
message: 「Well then, if I had been lucky, it might have hit.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that was nerve-wracking.」
If his concentration had lapsed for even a moment, it wouldn't be strange for him to have been sliced in two, VF and all.

name: Asahi
message: 「As expected, I couldn't beat Iori-sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Sorry about that, for going all out.」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, that's exactly how it should be.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I believed that Iori-sensei was not the kind of man to be defeated by someone like my current self.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That is exactly why you are the Iori-san I love.」

name: Iori
message: 「'Love,' that's a bit of an exaggeration...」

name: Asahi
message: 「It is not an exaggeration at all.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Have you forgotten, Iori-san, that I confessed my feelings to you before？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I remember it well.」
Asahi-chan came to me over and over, begging, "Please teach me Jindou."
I'd noticed, too, that Jindou wasn't the only source of her enthusiasm.

name: Asahi
message: 「I was so sad when you turned down my once-in-a-lifetime confession back then.」

name: Iori
message: 「I couldn't help it. You were still in elementary school back then, Asahi-chan.」

name: Asahi
message: 「In that case, is it okay now？」
True, she's an academy student now, and she's old enough to have some sense. Her figure has gotten really impressive, too.

name: Iori
message: 「No, I said no. We're teacher and student now, Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Isn't teacher and student perfectly fine?」

name: Asahi
message: 「At bedtime, I'd love to request some nighttime private lessons involving close physical contact.」

name: Iori
message: 「Nighttime private lessons... wait, no, no！」

name: Iori
message: 「Nighttime private lessons...

name: Iori
message: wait, no, no！」
That actually made my heart race a little.

name: Asahi
message: 「Why not？」

name: Iori
message: 「Listen, I'm the teacher for all the students in Takamura Class. I can't give just you special treatment, Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I see... Then I'll orchestrate things so that all the other students get expelled.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, definitely don't do that, okay？」
Asahi really says some disturbing things sometimes...
